mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.member_id, b.source_type, b.total_points, b.used_points, b.remain_points, b.gain_time, b.expire_time, b.status, b.ref_no, b.create_time from biz_point_batch b
mapper.select: where b.member_id = #{memberId} and b.status = 1 and b.remain_points > 0 order by b.expire_time asc, b.batch_id asc
mapper.update: update biz_point_batch set status = 2 where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 1 and remain_points = 0
